description: SvSlider in Svelte 5 as a filter block: a dual-thumb price range with range, min, max and step, ticks and labels on every mark, a formatValue function that prints dollar amounts, plus single sliders for rating and distance with live formatted readouts. Keyboard accessible and themed from the tokens.

faq.question: How do I get two thumbs?
faq.answer: Add range. The value becomes a [min, max] tuple, both thumbs respect step, and they cannot cross.

faq.question: How do I format the readout?
faq.answer: Pass formatValue, a function from number to string, which the slider uses for the value bubble and, with labels='all', for the tick labels too.

faq.question: Can the slider be vertical?
faq.answer: Yes. orientation='vertical' turns the track vertical with the same keyboard model, which suits volume and level controls.
